item.artDescription: The sarcophagus bears an artwork of <color=#D09B61FF>Natsuki Fry</color> being harmed by <color=#D09B61FF>Bean Down</color> with quick, efficient movements. <color=#D09B61FF>Bean</color> looks triumphant. Four beggars appear beneath the main subject. The work has a symbolic feeling and a rectangular structure. This illustration refers to the harming of <color=#D09B61FF>Natsuki</color> with a knife on 3rd of Septober, 5500.
